_source.object: A synthetic Host applied with server-side apply (kubectl apply --server-side --field-manager=example-deployer, kubectl v1.37.0) to a disposable local cluster (Kubernetes v1.37.0) with only the Host CRD installed: charts/clerum-crds/crds/host.yaml (sha256 acae500f8731ee6a6fa1175e9955e8b1e22652437273255c663bade7d9d7371c).
_source.signal: A managedFields entry with operation Apply (manager example-deployer) owns f:spec.f:approval. There is no last-applied-configuration annotation.
_source.synthetic: Every value comes from a made-up manifest. After the read, metadata.uid was removed, and metadata.creationTimestamp, metadata.resourceVersion and the managedFields time were set to the fixed values the other manifest-signal fixtures use. Everything else is as the apiserver returned it: spec, the managedFields managers, operations, apiVersions, fieldsTypes and fieldsV1 paths, and (client-side apply only) the last-applied-configuration annotation, which kubectl wrote.
